item.title: Show HN: okfctl
item.summary: I built a CLI tool to manage Open Knowledge Format (OKF) bundles. Knowledge bases, second brains, and LLM-Wikis now have a toolchain to complement the specification. Validate, lint, analyze, search, serve, and manage your knowledge. Go binary, agent plugin, and skills included. Please try it! I've been using it for about a month on home labs, work labs, team knowledge base repos, and more. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49376185 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
